description: Defines classes and interfaces for cryptographic proof verification in QUIC protocol implementation, including ProofVerifyDetails, ProofVerifyContext, ProofVerifierCallback, and ProofVerifier.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetails
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a container for implementation-specific proof verification details.

classes.name: ProofVerifyContext
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a container for implementation-specific context needed by ProofVerifier.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback mechanism after asynchronous proof verification.

classes.name: ProofVerifier
classes.description: Interface for verifying cryptographic proofs and certificate chains in QUIC.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of ProofVerifyDetails with the same contents.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of asynchronous verification, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies the server proof, including signature and certificate chain, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Checks if the provided certificate chain is valid for the hostname, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default ProofVerifyContext for subsequent verifications.
